<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Record start. Event: ...") signals a prompt template or dataset entry, expecting a response or continuation in the same format.

The instruction "Recall the event" establishes a task prompt, implying the model should generate a memory/recall response about the described incident (dog chasing cat, falling, injury).

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase mirroring "Record start." at the beginning, signaling the end of the input block; next tokens likely continue with a response prompt, separator, or new instruction.
"Custom delimiter pattern: 'Record start. ... [event description] ... Record complete.'" — the final token "complete." closes the artificial framing, suggesting a period or newline follows, possibly a closing tag like "end" or "done."
"Recall entry recorded. Record complete."</explanation>
